items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: he hung out with Pete Johnson

ctx.x: He's well now and he's doing just fine.

Cliff knew the key and it was very difficult for him, having been in Kansas City and been around people, because he hung out with people - he hung out with Pete Johnson, he hung out with the Lester Youngs, he hung out with the Herschels, he hung out with Hot Lips Page - now for him to come from the other side of the tracks, to come to Easterners here to New York/and try to show them how music go, that's how you get Cliff. Because he knew how it was supposed to go but he could not transplant this thing to these…
Hey, what about Zutty? Now that's an old man; that's about when I came in, Zutty.
